summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Grayscale Avalanche Staking ETF (GAVA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long avax, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed fund that provides exposure to the price performance of spot AVAX, the native token of the Avalanche blockchain network, with the potential for additional returns through staking rewards. The percentage of the staked AVAX is disclosed on the fund website daily. GAVA was launched on Mar 12, 2026 and is issued by Grayscale.
